title: Menvier M750 / M800 menu map
baseline: Engineer: 496966 Issue 5 (2006), M750/M800 subset. Manager: separate later M800/M2000 manual 11821957 (2010). Firmware versions are not asserted as interchangeable.
scope: Broad documented Engineer levels 1–2 and later Manager levels 1–2, with factual value catalogues and explicit interactive limits. Does not represent Menvier30/40/100/300 or TS700/TS900.

sources.scope: Separate later M800 Manager baseline. Calendar timers differ from the older engineer guide; user and engineer roots are not merged.

sources.title: M2000/M800 User’s Guide
sources.edition: Part 12062453; 2010 copyright; keypad diagram printed p3
sources.pageNumbering: Printed Arabic page + 2 = one-based PDF page.

numbering.explanation: Addresses such as 2.7.3.4 mean a local hotkey at each menu level, each followed by ENT. They are not a single four-digit root shortcut. The four-digit zone address identifies a network/device/input.

examples.meaning: Engineer Menu 2 → Built In Tests → Equipment → Zone Resistance
Panel zone 2, not a menu address
In Engineer context: Zones Advanced. In User context: Omit Zones.

caveats: Later Manager calendar timers are separate from older Engineer timer menus.
Order is not a numeric key unless code is explicitly present.

navigation.action: Scroll or choose a local option number, then ENT enters.
Back one step; confirm at the leave-menus prompt to persist engineer changes.
Contextual attribute/omit change or log details. It is a physical key separate from #.

gaps.title: Engineer and Manager editions differ
gaps.question: Which exact M750/M800 firmware revision is installed, and can you provide its matching Manager manual?
gaps.reason: The pinned engineer guide is 2006; the public M800 Manager guide is 2010. Their timer menus differ and are kept in separate contexts.
gaps.neededEvidence: Matching panel model and firmware display, then a photograph or video of this specific menu.

gaps.title: Timer and counter accepted ranges
gaps.question: What minimum and maximum does the matching keypad accept for each timer?
gaps.reason: The manual illustrates three-digit fields but does not state all accepted ranges. FINDR labels the 000–999 training input instead of claiming hardware range validation.
gaps.neededEvidence: Matching panel model and firmware display, then a photograph or video of this specific menu.

gaps.title: Output record and conditional flow
gaps.question: Can you capture Panel Outputs through System/Ward/Zone source selection, inversion and pulse duration?
gaps.reason: All function value labels are sourced; conditional field order, hardware bank population and gate logic require further keypad verification.
gaps.neededEvidence: Matching panel model and firmware display, then a photograph or video of this specific menu.

gaps.title: Text-field lengths
gaps.question: Can you verify lengths for Reset Message, Location Text, Banner and auxiliary tamper names?
gaps.reason: The source explicitly gives 16-character zone descriptions; other custom text editors use a 16-character training limit pending physical verification.
gaps.neededEvidence: Matching panel model and firmware display, then a photograph or video of this specific menu.

gaps.title: Printed table discrepancies
gaps.question: Can you confirm Time Switch capacity and the AC Bypass choices on the matching firmware?
gaps.reason: The old guide’s time-switch prose says three while a diagram shows hotkeys 1–4. AC Bypass heading and prose differ; the prose values Always/Healthy/Never are retained.
gaps.neededEvidence: Matching panel model and firmware display, then a photograph or video of this specific menu.

gaps.title: Special operations and attached devices
gaps.question: Can you provide flows for custom gates, false setting, radio devices and network error reset?
gaps.reason: These branches remain explicitly limited rather than inventing results from disconnected hardware.
gaps.neededEvidence: Matching panel model and firmware display, then a photograph or video of this specific menu.

gaps.title: Older volume and communications field bounds
gaps.question: Can you confirm the older M800 volume range and permitted telephone/account lengths?
gaps.reason: The later Manager guide verifies volume 0–7; the older engineer guide does not state the numeric maximum. Phone and account field lengths remain labelled training bounds.
gaps.neededEvidence: Matching panel model and firmware display, then a photograph or video of this specific menu.

gaps.title: Manager setting and test prompt variants
gaps.question: Can you provide the matching 2010 M800 User guide and captures of Bell Test, walk-test result review and exception allocation?
gaps.reason: The physical bell/strobe sequence, context-sensitive set/unset prompt and per-record calendar allocation are not represented as exact firmware sequences.
gaps.neededEvidence: Matching panel model and firmware display, then a photograph or video of this specific menu.
